title: Red Sox reportedly acquire catcher Adley Rutschman from Orioles
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: The Red Sox acquired catcher Adley Rutschman from the Orioles, sending Carlos Narvaez and several prospects to Baltimore.
Rutschman, a three-time All-Star, has slashed .251/.331/.433 with eight home runs in 67 games this season.
Rutschman is seen as a significant defensive and offensive upgrade over Boston's current catching corps.

title: The top four fall foliage destinations in the U.S. are not in New England, according to Priceline
author: Kristi Palma
bullets: Priceline ranked the Adirondacks in New York as the top fall foliage destination in 2026.
Bretton Woods, NH, the Berkshires, MA, and Stowe, VT ranked 5th, 8th, and 9th respectively in the U.S. list.
New England destinations previously ranked higher; in 2024, Bretton Woods was among the top three.

title: Bruce Springsteen, whose wife was treated in Boston, salutes Pan-Mass Challenge participants
author: Peter Chianca
bullets: Bruce Springsteen saluted Pan-Mass Challenge participants in a video message at the 'State of PMC' program in Worcester.
Springsteen's wife, Patti Scialfa, has been treated for multiple myeloma at Dana-Farber Cancer Institute and is now in remission.
Springsteen praised the Pan-Mass Challenge, which has raised over $1 billion for cancer research since its inception in 1980.

title: 1 dead, 4 injured in overnight Hyde Park shooting
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: A shooting in Hyde Park early Monday left one dead and four injured, police reported.
Boston police responded at 12:38 a.m. to 1184 Hyde Park Ave, finding five adults with gunshot wounds.
Authorities urge sharing information with the BPD Homicide Unit at 617-343-4470 or anonymously through 1-800-494-8477.

title: Review & setlist: Zac Brown Band brings ‘Love & Fear’ – and a whole lot of joy – to Fenway
author: Chris Stevens
bullets: Zac Brown Band performed at Fenway Park, marking their 15th sold-out show there, as part of the 'Love & Fear Tour'.
The concert featured guest performances by Mac MacAnally and Boston's Gary Cherone, with songs like 'A Pirate Looks at Forty'.
Zac Brown announced a giveaway of free cruises for attendees, a surprise worth an estimated $40 million.

title: Vermont Green FC repeats feat with second straight undefeated championship season
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: Vermont Green FC completed a second consecutive undefeated USL League Two season, winning the championship against Flint City Bucks.
Head coach Chris Taylor remains unbeaten with Vermont Green FC, achieving 35 wins and seven draws in a 42-game run.
Vermont's soccer success includes Vermont Green's women’s team reaching the USL W League National Final in its first season.

title: Review & setlists: Boston favorite Extreme steals Mötley Crüe’s thunder in Mansfield
author: Christopher Hurley
bullets: Extreme impressed fans with a dynamic performance as opening act for Mötley Crüe at Xfinity Center on August 1, 2026.
Boston-based Extreme performed an 11-song set featuring both new and classic hits, engaging a growing audience effectively.
Mötley Crüe delivered a 16-song show, closing the night with iconic tracks and theatrics, including pyrotechnics at Xfinity Center.

title: BPD searching for missing Roxbury man, 84, with dementia
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Boston Police are searching for James Clarke, 84, of Roxbury, who was reported missing from his Hawthorne Street home.
Clarke, who has dementia, is 5'11", 140 pounds, and was last seen wearing a black hat and blue flannel shirt.
Clarke frequents Nubian Square, Ruggles Station, and MBTA stops; public assistance is requested to locate him.

title: Livestream: Lindsay Clancy murder trial enters second week after jurors hear from more first responders
author: Abby Patkin
bullets: Lindsay Clancy's murder trial continues as jurors hear testimony from emergency responders and medical staff about her condition.
Healthcare providers at Brigham and Women's Hospital testified about Clancy's temporary delirium and confusion during her ICU stay.
Massachusetts State Police Sgt. Rose Stoffers documented Clancy's injuries and hospital medication following her Jan. 2023 hospital admission.

title: Zac Brown gave free cruises to fans at Sunday’s Fenway concert — all of them
author: Chris Stevens
bullets: Zac Brown gave 35,000 concertgoers at Fenway Park a free cruise for two via Margaritaville at Sea.
The giveaway celebrated the Zac Brown Band's 15th consecutive sold-out show at the iconic venue.
Fans must redeem their cruise trips within a year, having signed up by midnight on the concert day.
